name: How long does a typical roof installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof installation project depends on factors like the roof's size, its complexity (e.g., steep pitches, multiple valleys), weather conditions, and the type of material being installed. A standard asphalt shingle roof on an average-sized home can often be completed within 2-5 days. More complex projects involving tile or metal roofing, or those requiring extensive decking repair, may take longer, sometimes up to a week or more. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most roof installations take 2-5 days for average-sized homes with asphalt shingles. Larger or more complex projects, or those with different materials, can take longer.
